description: Code quality lint rules for Rust — flags debug macros, incomplete TODOs, and non-idiomatic iteration

rules.description: No dbg!() macro in production code
rules.message: Remove dbg!() before committing — use a proper logging crate for structured output

rules.description: No todo!() macro in shipped code
rules.message: todo!() panics at runtime — implement or track as an issue before shipping

rules.description: Prefer iterator methods over manual index loops
rules.message: Use .iter().enumerate() or direct iteration instead of index-based loops
